This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 21-01-2026 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Atlântico Distribuição SA, with its registered office at Avenida da Liberdade
50, Porto ("Party A"), and Docupath Solutions Lda, with its registered office at Avenida da Liberdade
50, Lisboa ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 24 months from the Effective Date unless
terminated earlier in accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall
use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York.
